instruction_summary: Study 001 (book, GO-WITH-SCOPE): grade Piore & Sabel (1984) checkable claims (families B,C,D) and predictions P1/P3/P4 against public statistics with per-row verdicts and NO pooled score; P2 is study 002.

steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install pandas numpy matplotlib openpyxl

steps.description: Gate A1: sha256 integrity of 13 staged data files vs PROVENANCE (13/13 match)
Gate A1b: re-verify all 37 §I.1b attribution locators (grep -F on HTML, pdftotext|tr|grep on PDFs) — all hit at expected counts
Gate A2/A3: coverage sanity + staging/branch flags (no williams1987/indstat/ds140 -> restoration events not fired)
Declared in-run fetches: FRED (OPHNFB/MFPNFBS/MANEMP/PAYEMS) + Eurostat nama_10r_2gdp BW(DE1); all HTTP 200
Block B/C: compute claim series + verdicts (B1,B2,B3,C1,C4,C5,C2/C3,D1,D2,P1,P3,P4) and scorecard
Figures: B1 saturation bars, C1 Emilia-Romagna spliced income, D1 two-panel plant-size
Block D: findings.md, report.md, result_card.json, followup_summary.json

key_results.verdict_tally: 9 checkable claims + 3 gradeable predictions: 6 supported, 1 partially supported, 0 contradicted, 5 not-checkable
key_results.B1_durable_saturation: supported; 4/4 durables >=0.93x their 1984 penetration by 1973 (Auto .943, Fridge 1.000, Washer .930, TV .983)
key_results.B3_productivity_slowdown: supported; labor prod growth 2.58%->1.58%, TFP 1.71%->0.58% (1950-73 vs 1974-84)
key_results.C1_emilia_romagna: supported; 7th(1951)->+29% vs Italy(1980)->2nd place(1995); +19.5% vs Italy / 116.8% of EU27 in 2024
key_results.C4_steel: not-checkable (attribution); US EAF 71.8% (2024 worldsteel), 1970s level not-checkable (data)
key_results.D1_plant_size: verdict not-checkable (attribution); data story QUALIFIED - reversal in manufacturing (small share 27.7%->32.5%, mean size 58.7->45.8) but NOT economy-wide (55.6%->52.7%, 16.2->18.3)
key_results.P1_no_recovery: supported; manuf VA share US 16.1->10.5 (1997->2021), DE 24.6->18.9 (1991->2023), JP 23.4->19.5 (1994->2023), WDI NV.IND.MANF.ZS TRUE coverage [PS-PROV-1 relabel from mislabeled '1984->2023'; series starts USA 1997/DEU 1991/JPN 1994, no 1984 value exists]; US emp share 19.0%->8.0% (1984->2025, FRED, vintage-clean leg that drives the verdict); direction unaffected
key_results.P3_flexible_spec: partially supported (modal): districts persisted; dominance possibility not realized
key_results.a1b_locators: 37/37 verified at expected counts; no source dropped
key_results.a1_hashes: 13/13 staged data files match PROVENANCE sha256

comparison_to_original.original: none (book, GO-WITH-SCOPE; no replication_score.json or verdicts.json exists)
comparison_to_original.followup: per-row verdict scorecard, no pooled score
comparison_to_original.note: confirmed absent by design; this study IS the verification layer
reversal confirmed in manufacturing; opposite economy-wide

deviations: B3: used FRED OPHNFB (nonfarm-business labor productivity, 1947+) in place of named OPHMFG (starts 1987, cannot reach pre-1973 window) per the 'or successor' clause; series are nonfarm-business not manufacturing-only. Logged in fetch_log.json.
C4: 1970s-84 US EAF level not-checkable (data) - USGS DS140 blocked, no OA Minerals-Yearbook quote staged; only 2024 worldsteel endpoint computable (not substituted from memory).
C2/C3: Eurostat nama_10r_2gdp has no 1980s backcast (starts 2000); Italian district sector series not staged (next-tick item). Modern BW data story reported only.
P1: DE/JP manufacturing-employment-share series not staged; VA shares substitute for those two economies' employment leg.

P1 vintage relabel (PS-PROV-3 corrective study 003): the WDI manufacturing-VA shares were mislabeled '1984->2023'; they are nearest-year substitutions (series starts USA 1997/DEU 1991/JPN 1994, USA ends 2021) and are relabeled to the TRUE years. The employment leg (FRED, genuine 1984->2025) is vintage-clean and drives the verdict; direction unaffected. See 003 results/card_corrections.csv.

Schema note (PS-C2 / uniform-evaluator): neither result_card.json nor followup_summary.json has a score field, so none was set to null or hand-worked-around; verdict-count tallies used. No replication_score.json/verdicts.json exists for this GO-WITH-SCOPE book by design.
